newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude Medical Inc Q1 net off, revs rise.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude Medical Inc Q1 net off, revs rise.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Q1 1996 included gains of $10 million and $3 million relating to the sale of a business and settlement of a legal action, respectively, and costs of $5 million each related to the Daig acquisition and a purchased research and development charge. Q1 1997 included Telectronics losses of $8 million, interest expense of $3 million and a negative foreign currency effect of $2 million.
Adjusting for these unusual items, Q1 1997 income before taxes would have been $56 million compared to Q1 1996 adjusted income before taxes of $55 million.

Current and historical results include the combined results of St. Jude and Daig Corp reflecting the stock-for-stock merger completed in the second quarter 1996. 1997 also includes the post acquisition operating results of Telectronics which was acquired November 29, 1996.
